description: This file defines a final class 'WatchReplyCoordinator' that manages reply events from a watch interface. It includes decision logic for handling reply events, queuing, deduplication, and requeuing mechanisms, primarily to coordinate reply events based on gateway connectivity state.

classes.name: WatchReplyCoordinator
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing reply events from a watch interface, including deduplication, queuing, and dispatching of reply events based on connectivity.

methods.name: ingest
methods.description: Processes a WatchQuickReplyEvent, determines whether to drop, queue, deduplicate, or forward the reply based on its content and gateway connectivity status.

methods.name: drainIfConnected
methods.description: Returns all queued reply events if the gateway is connected, clearing the queue.

methods.name: requeueFront
methods.description: Re-inserts a WatchQuickReplyEvent at the front of the queue.

methods.name: queuedCount
methods.description: Returns the number of queued reply events.
